View, beside Search downloaded mail, switches between Right preview, Bottom preview and Separate window. The choice and bottom list height are saved on this computer across mailboxes and search. Drag the divider to resize a preview, or focus it and use Left / Right for a right preview and Up / Down for a bottom preview. Separate window gives the list the available width: single-click selects a message without opening or marking it read; double-click or press Enter to open the existing independent reader. Row actions and multiple selection remain available. Delete and Backspace in the main Mail window move the selected messages to Trash after review, including selected rows hidden by a filter. The reader Delete button shows the selected count and uses the same selection. With no selection, preview Delete targets the open message; Separate window needs a selection. R, A and F still require exactly one visible selected message in Separate window. The open View menu blocks message and selection keys. Independent readers keep their own message target. Without a selection, preview shortcuts wait for loading to succeed. Outbox keeps its scheduled-message preview below the list. Small windows stack previews below the list while keeping your saved choice. Changing view preserves column order, sorting, search, selection and scroll position.
